description: A full splat applied to an object gives a tuple containing the object
notes: The spec's prose says a value that isn't a tuple, list or set is coerced into a single-value list, but its examples say any_object.*.id is equivalent to [any_object.id] and any_number.* to [any_number], which are tuples. hashicorp/hcl wraps the value in a one-element tuple (SplatExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
